🎉 Huge congratulations to Team Falcon Bots! 🏆✨
Proud members of the DIU Robotics Club from the Department of Computing and Information Systems (CIS), Daffodil International University, have secured 1st Runner-up (Silver Medal) 🥈 at the World Robot Games 2026 – Bangladesh National Qualifier (Programmable Line Robot Competition – Senior Category)!
With this achievement, the team has qualified for the World Robot Games 2026 International Round in Japan 🇯🇵! 🤖🌏
👥 Team Falcon Bots:
• Team Leader: Fayek Ahanaf
• Members: Nafisa Tabassum Nusrat, Shakila Akter, Md. Tawfiqur Rahman Srijon
Wishing them all the best as they represent DIU and Bangladesh on the global stage! 🇧🇩✨

Unlock the Algorithm Programming Contest, Fall 2026

Competitive programming is widely recognized as an effective way to enhance problem-solving abilities and strengthen programming skills. To encourage students’ interest in programming and foster a competitive programming mindset among them, DIU CPC from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering, DIU, is once again organizing the Unlock the Algorithm Programming Contest, Fall 2026. This contest provides an excellent platform for participants to evaluate their current skills and gain valuable experience in a competitive environment.

Only students who are enrolled in the Algorithm course are eligible to participate. This is an individual contest, so team participation is not allowed. All participants will receive food and a T-shirt.
